item.text: The helper now extracts lowercase ASCII alphanumeric runs and joins them with underscores, so punctuation and non-ASCII characters are excluded while punctuation between words still separates them. I added regression coverage for the requested title and whitespace handling; I’m running the requested suite and reviewing the final diff.
